messages.content:
SYSTEM items:
[0] The group has reached an agreement to pursue a wooden, customizable case for the device.
[1] Maintain rubber-like buttons to preserve tactile experience; not wood.
[2] Include a battery-life indicator light that dims as the battery dies.
[3] Maintain simple design for now until display cost is known.

[0] Proceed to a prototype based on the simple control layout and the agreed component concept; the display remains a separate cost-dependent option.
[1] Use an advanced chip and a customizable wooden case, with rubber rather than wooden buttons. The ergonomic layout carries forward the simple-interface direction.
[2] Keep the simple design without committing to an LCD until the extra display cost is known.
[3] Explore outsourcing custom-case manufacture at low cost while paying a fair wage; no manufacturer, contact owner or supply agreement was selected.
